limits.github_minutes_storage: Public standard runners free (gh-bill-1). Private: Free 2,000 min / 500 MB; Pro 3,000 / 1 GB; Team 3,000 / 2 GB; Enterprise Cloud 50,000 / 50 GB (gh-bill-3). Linux 2-core $0.006/min (gh-bill-2). Artifact retention, per-artifact size and download access: NOT FOUND.
limits.pages: 1 GB site (gh-pages-1); 100 GB/month soft (gh-pages-2); 10 builds/h soft, not for custom Actions workflows (gh-pages-3, -4); 1 GB repo recommendation (gh-pages-5).
limits.r2: $0.015/GB-mo, 10 GB free; Class A $4.50/M (1M free); Class B $0.36/M (10M free); egress free; deletes free (r2-1 to r2-4).
limits.s3: $0.023/GB-mo first 50 TB; PUT $0.005/1k; GET $0.0004/1k (s3-aws-1, s3-1); 100 GB/month internet transfer out free, aggregated (s3-2).
limits.cloudfront: 1 TB transfer out and 10M requests free per month; $0.085/GB next 9 TB; $0.0100 per 10,000 HTTPS (cf-1).
limits.b2: 10 GB free; egress free to 3x average stored, then $0.01/GB; $6.95/TB/mo as extracted; transactions free (b2-1 to b2-4, b2-6).
limits.servers: DO Basic $4.00/mo, 500 GiB, $0.01/GiB beyond (do-1, do-2). Lightsail $5 or $3.50/mo, 1 TB, overage rate not found (ls-1, ls-2). Hetzner CX23 EUR 5.49 / USD 6.49/mo from 15 June 2026, net of VAT, excl. IPv4 (hz-1, hz-3).

noaa_access.region: us-east-1 for both buckets (registry pages; x-amz-bucket-region header).
noaa_access.anonymous_read: Live check: HTTP 200 with no requester-charged header (noaa-live-check). AWS: Requester Pays buckets do not support anonymous requests (aws-rp-3), so these were not Requester Pays for anonymous reads at check time (inference).
noaa_access.default_payer: Bucket owner pays storage and data transfer unless Requester Pays is set (aws-rp-1, aws-rp-2).
noaa_access.reader_cost: Reader pays $0 in AWS data charges under that default. Reader's own costs: compute (Actions minutes or EC2 hours) and any onward egress.
noaa_access.github_runner_vs_ec2: Linux and Windows GitHub-hosted runners are VMs in Microsoft Azure (gh-runner-1). Their reads are internet transfer from S3's view, billed to the owner under the default rule. A same-region EC2 reader falls in the same-region exception (s3-4). EC2 pricing wording not extracted (unverified). Network speed or cost not measured.
noaa_access.sponsorship: Program page: 'covers the cost of storing and sharing' (aws-od-4, truncated); whether that covers internet egress is unverified. NOAA NODD page: no cost statement (noaa-nodd-1).

ops_and_staleness.github_failures: Creator e-mail by default; a later cron editor takes over (gh-notify-1, -2); failed-only option (gh-notify-3); badge (gh-badge-1); workflow_run webhook (gh-hook-1).
ops_and_staleness.dropped_runs: Queued jobs may be dropped at high load (gh-sched-4). Whether that sends any notice is unverified, so staleness must be detected from timestamps.
ops_and_staleness.object_storage: Upload errors surface in the job. Provider alerts unverified for R2, B2 and servers; CloudWatch alarm $0.10 per metric (s3-aws-1 doc).
ops_and_staleness.server: No GitHub path; needs own heartbeat or alert.

staleness_design_not_built.fields: schema; published_utc; last_run_utc; next_expected_utc = last_run_utc + cadence + grace; source_valid_utc per input; layers[] {name, file, bytes, sha256, valid_utc, max_age_min}
staleness_design_not_built.crew_rule: If now > next_expected_utc: Stale, with age. If a layer's now minus valid_utc exceeds max_age_min: 'Data unavailable' for that layer (repo-agents-rule5). Keep the last good copy with its age (README section 4). Never an all-clear.
staleness_design_not_built.thresholds: repo-globe-d12 (MRMS 10 min, GOES 15 min, alerts 10 min, imagery daily).
staleness_design_not_built.caveat: A dropped run leaves last_run_utc old, so the timestamp check does not rely on notifications. Crew clock accuracy unverified.
